instruction: I went on a few trips each with some of my friends. My Simple Note has information on who owes whom what from each trip. I have already created Splitwise groups for the trips. Record the expenses accordingly in the respective groups.
notes: Modeled as: read passwords, log into Simple Note, search for the trip note, read it, log into Splitwise, list groups (gives group ids and member emails for name-to-email resolution), then record one expense per entry in the note into the matching group, then complete_task without an answer. The exact number of trips/expenses is not known from the instruction; the model assumes one note covering two trips with two expenses each (4 record_expense calls, matching the 11-call reference length) and the expense objects are domain constants so complete_task can require every expense to be recorded. Each expense carries description, paid_amount, payer_email, debtor_emails, debt_amounts and group_id as runtime-bound objects; debtor/amount lists are single list-valued objects. Only Expense/ExpenseShare/Notification records may change, so no other mutating actions are modeled.

plan: (splitwise-record-expense description-a1 amount-a1 payer-a1-email debtors-a1 splitwise-token debt-amounts-a1 group-trip-a expense-a1 note-trips)
(splitwise-record-expense description-a2 amount-a2 payer-a2-email debtors-a2 splitwise-token debt-amounts-a2 group-trip-a expense-a2 note-trips)
